$doc: Canonical, machine-readable support matrix. docs/PLATFORMS.md explains it. Each surface on each target records evidence separately: compiles, unit_tested, simulation_tested, hardware_tested, ui_tested. Values: true (done, with `how`), false (not done), "blocked" (needs something this project lacks), "n/a". A cross-compile is never hardware support.
